transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... since my grandson was killed, I just haven't been right. It's hard to explain, but my daughter can sit right beside me, holding my hand, and I know I love her. I know that in my head. But I just cannot feel the warmth of it inside me at all anymore.
Do unwanted memories of what happened to your grandson keep popping into your mind even when you try not to think about it?

Yes, they do. It's... well, it happens when I'm just doing normal things. I'll be sitting there folding a quilt square, or maybe just reaching for my cup of tea, and... all of a sudden, I hear those shots again. And I see him lying there on the ground outside the community center. It's... it's like it's happening right in front of me all over again.
How long ago did your grandson pass away?
It has been six days. Just six days since he was killed outside the community center. All of this has been going on since then.
